details: One Refining includes around 20+ custom applications with Third-party tools and databases, these applications are used by all the refineries of BP like Castellon, Gelsenkirchen, and Toledo to name a few of them.

One Refining is the upgrade project from MOSS-2007 to SharePoint 2010 which includes all the Migration of One Refining applications to 2010 and dealing with Bug fixing which rose during migration and this includes all the SharePoint features like custom web parts, feature handling, BDCs, master pages, page layouts, content types... Etc. here are some of a few custom applications that integrates with all the refineries in order to continue their daily business requirements – Logbook application which deals with comments and tasks with regards to Area ,Unit, Assets, Assignees for a specified refinery in turn deals with’ mpro’ database in order to store the data for the specified refineries. Game Plan is the one which mainly concentrates on Refinery wide users’ requirements using the Microsoft office InfoPath forms and it will merge different InfoPath forms with data entered. Document Management System (DMS) which mainly gets the data from Documentum and displays the data based on query given by the user with content type and there are complex applications like Operating envelopes (deals with refinery wide Operating Points, Summary Reports of the Refineries, Trend Charts of Refineries etc.) Analyzer Performance (AP- deals with Control Grid, Status of the Control points etc.) Advisory Reports (deals mainly with Reports based on Refinery wide filter values).

Game Plan is the one which mainly concentrates on Refinery wide users’ requirements using the Microsoft office InfoPath forms and it will merge different InfoPath forms with data entered. Document Management System (DMS) which mainly gets the data from Documentum and displays the data based on query given by the user with content type and there are complex applications like Operating envelopes (deals with refinery wide Operating Points, Summary Reports of the Refineries, Trend Charts of Refineries etc.) Analyzer Performance (AP- deals with Control Grid, Status of the Control points etc.) Advisory Reports (deals mainly with Reports based on Refinery wide filter values).
